decisions.summary: Add a read-only organization operating model so Athanor routes LFG and LFG-goal work through an explicit office/stage graph with receipt requirements, learning governance, and no live listener or registered-agent expansion by default.

verification_commands.expected: status pass with missing_command_mappings 0, registered_agent_additions 0, irreversible_actions 0, and no default live listener
focused P26 organization model and integration tests pass

observed_results.summary: P26 adds docs/organization-operating-model.md, a schema-backed read-only gate, LFG/LFG-goal skill routing text, package index coverage, CI coverage, and a deep-research comparison report. The model maps current Athanor commands into company-like intake, planning, execution, verification, release, postmortem, and memory-update stages without adding live runtime surfaces.

decisions.rollback_or_follow_up: Rollback by removing the CI step and skill routing text if the model proves too prescriptive; follow up with runtime receipts only after the read-only stage graph remains stable.
